entries.name: variable declaration
entries.description: A typed declaration creates an object whose lifetime and type are known at compile time.
entries.definition: A typed declaration creates an object whose lifetime and type are known at compile time.
entries.template:
int answer = 42;
volatile int sink = answer;

entries.name: if statement
entries.description: An if statement evaluates a contextual Boolean expression and executes one selected branch.
entries.definition: An if statement evaluates a contextual Boolean expression and executes one selected branch.
entries.template:
int value = 42;
if (value > 0) { value += 1; } else { value = 0; }

entries.name: for statement
entries.description: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and an iteration expression.
entries.definition: A for statement combines initialization, a continuation condition, and an iteration expression.
entries.template:
int total = 0;
for (int index = 0; index < 4; ++index) { total += index; }

entries.name: range-for statement
entries.description: A range-based for statement visits each element exposed by a compatible range expression.
entries.definition: A range-based for statement visits each element exposed by a compatible range expression.

entries.name: lambda expression
entries.description: A lambda expression creates an unnamed function object and explicitly controls captured state.
entries.definition: A lambda expression creates an unnamed function object and explicitly controls captured state.
entries.template:
auto doubleValue = [](int value) { return value * 2; };
volatile int answer = doubleValue(21);

entries.name: class declaration
entries.description: A class defines a user type with explicit access control, constructors, state, and member functions.
entries.definition: A class defines a user type with explicit access control, constructors, state, and member functions.

entries.name: enum class declaration
entries.description: A scoped enumeration keeps enumerator names inside the enum type and does not implicitly convert to integers.
entries.definition: A scoped enumeration keeps enumerator names inside the enum type and does not implicitly convert to integers.

entries.name: generic lambda
entries.description: A generic lambda uses placeholder parameter types to generate a call operator for each used argument type.
entries.definition: A generic lambda uses placeholder parameter types to generate a call operator for each used argument type.
entries.template:
auto identity = [](auto value) { return value; };
volatile int answer = identity(42);

entries.name: structured binding
entries.description: A structured binding introduces names for the elements of an array or aggregate-like object.
entries.definition: A structured binding introduces names for the elements of an array or aggregate-like object.

entries.name: try and catch
entries.description: A try block transfers control to a matching catch handler when an exception is thrown.
